title: Credential
description: A signed, holder-owned projection of an accepted Claim (§5). This record is CREST's own bookkeeping, not the credential: there is deliberately no credential register (§3), the worker's wallet holds the only complete copy, and the status list is the single central fact.

subjectRef.description: The pairwise subject the credential is about. Never a national identifier (W9).

statusListEntry.description: One bit meaning 'still stands', carrying nothing else. Unlinkable bulk data by design (§9).

provenance.description: Carried onto the credential so a verifier can derive the tier without reaching back into CREST. Facts, never the tier itself (§6).

digest.description: Of the issued credential document, so a presented credential can be tied to this record without storing the document.
